data.standardized_narrative: Document images provided were not machine-readable. I could not reliably extract an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement or a clear opening (1 January) gross claims outstanding from the Balance Sheet or the movement note. Gross written premium total and a divisional premium split were visible, but reserves and prior-year development figures could not be unambiguously read from the scanned images.
data.data_quality_notes: PDF provided as scanned images; OCR/text extraction failed. Key reserve lines (gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year balance and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column) could not be unambiguously read. Gross premium total (2209.8) and divisional premium headings were legible but one divisional amount was adjusted to ensure the segment totals match the reported total (the source scanned table showed slight numeric mismatch). All reserve-related numeric fields are therefore null. If a higher-fidelity (text/PDF) copy is provided, I can extract accurate gross claims outstanding and gross prior-year development figures.
